name: @absolutejs/autoscaler
description: Horizontal-scaling policy used by the hosted AbsoluteJS.ai platform and available to any Bun control plane. Evaluates pluggable signals against declarative scaling policy and drives a caller-supplied actuator.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && absolute-changelog check
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
